_about: What Pendulum ships and offers to download, with each licence. scripts/third-party-notices.ps1 builds THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md from this and the packages the App actually uses: every package must have an entry here, and every entry here must still ship. Licence evidence is each package's own nuspec and licence or notice files.

packages.copyright: Leszek Pomianowski and WPF UI Contributors
packages.note: Embeds the Fluent System Icons fonts (MIT). Its notices also list Microsoft's Segoe Fluent Icons font, which Pendulum and WPF-UI use by name from Windows and don't ship.

packages.copyright: The ggml authors (whisper.cpp and ggml); Whisper.net: Sandro Hanea
packages.nativeSource: whisper.cpp f24588a272ae8e23280d9c220536437164e6ed28, the submodule Whisper.net 1.9.1 builds from
packages.note: The native whisper.cpp and ggml libraries in runtimes\, built by Whisper.net's windows-scripts.ps1 with ggml's defaults for llamafile and KleidiAI (both off), so neither Mozilla's llamafile code nor Arm's KleidiAI is in them. They use the Visual C++ and OpenMP runtimes found on the PC (VCRUNTIME140, MSVCP140, VCOMP140), which Pendulum doesn't ship.
For macOS only: nothing of it is copied into the Windows app.

runtimePacks.name: Windows Desktop runtime (WPF and Windows Forms)
